verdict.rationale: Runpod documents official Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript and Go for working with endpoints programmatically. It also ships an official `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package that gives typed Vercel AI SDK access to Public Endpoints, plus Flash's standalone `@Endpoint` functions for running Python on remote GPUs. Missing for 10: evidence that the SDKs cover Pods, volumes and clusters beyond Serverless, SDK reference depth (only one-line descriptions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
